MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "None of these items felt relevant enough for me to choose now.",
    "The earbuds have some connection to my earlier headset purchase, but that connection alone does not mean I need new audio equipment."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The streaming players, Alexa devices, and camera do not solve the computer connection or accessory needs reflected in my purchases.",
    "The memory cards could be useful if I had a device needing storage, but I have no identified need for either a single card or a two-pack.",
    "Having bought a headset does not give me a current reason to buy a speaker or replace it with wireless earbuds."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seem to treat interest in computer accessories as interest in electronics generally.",
    "My earlier audio purchase seems to have been stretched into interest in other listening devices without a clear reason to buy them."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Several of my purchases connect existing equipment: a WiFi adapter, USB expansion card, display cable, and USB Ethernet adapter. That practical purpose matters more to me than simply being an electronic device.",
    "My purchases are spread far apart, and I usually need a specific problem to solve before choosing another accessory.",
    "Compatibility with the equipment I already use would give me a stronger reason to consider an accessory than a broad resemblance to something I bought years ago."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized a broad interest in electronics but missed my occasional, specific need to connect or adapt existing equipment."
}
